# Field

Form field layout: FieldLabel, control, FieldDescription and FieldError (role=alert, linked via aria-describedby). FieldSet + FieldLegend group related fields.

## Import

```tsx
import { Field, FieldContent, FieldDescription, FieldError, … } from "@cesuain/ui";
// or the per-component entry point
import { Field } from "@cesuain/ui/field";
```

## API

Exports: `Field`, `FieldContent`, `FieldDescription`, `FieldError`, `FieldGroup`, `FieldLabel`, `FieldLegend`, `FieldSeparator`, `FieldSet`, `fieldVariants`.

Types: `FieldErrorProps`, `FieldLabelProps`, `FieldLegendProps`, `FieldProps`.

Props, defaults and live examples are on the Storybook Docs page, generated from the TypeScript types.

## Accessibility

- Behaviour and semantics are summarized above; keyboard and screen reader behaviour follow the WAI-ARIA pattern of the underlying primitive.
- `field.test.tsx` covers rendering, variants and interaction with Testing Library and runs axe-core on the rendered output (contrast is checked at token level). Every story also runs axe-core's default rule set in the Storybook browser tests; violations fail the run.
- Colors come from semantic tokens whose contrast is checked in both themes by `pnpm tokens:check`.
